Your Salalah itinerary • 5 days / 4 nights

Discover your Salalah journey.

Explore the highlights of your five-day Salalah trip. Every destination is paired with a genuine matching photograph, while journey and hotel moments use real travel and property photography.

Day 1

UAE to Salalah

Pickup • Border formalities • Refreshment stop • Overnight journey

Night 1: Luxury bus

Meet the tour at your confirmed UAE pickup point and settle into the luxury coach. Complete UAE exit and Oman entry formalities with guidance from the tour team, take a scheduled refreshment break, stop for dinner in Ibri at your own expense, then continue overnight to Salalah by luxury bus.

Luxury-Bus Journey to Salalah

Meet the tour at your confirmed UAE pickup point and settle into the luxury coach.Complete UAE exit and Oman entry formalities with guidance from the tour team.Take a scheduled refreshment break during the journey to relax and recharge.Pause for dinner in Ibri at your own expense before continuing through the night.The overnight journey brings the group comfortably into Salalah for the Day 2 program.

Day 2

Arrive in Salalah & discover the west coast

Hotel arrival • Mughsail coast • Culture & souq

Lunch + Dinner

Arrive in Salalah and check in at the hotel, followed by buffet lunch. Continue to Mughsail Beach, Marneef Cave and the seasonal Mughsail blowholes, then visit Cheraman Perumal Tomb and Souq Al Haffa. Return for buffet dinner and your first hotel night.

Arrive in Salalah & Hotel Check-in

Arrive in Salalah and step into a comfortable resort base after the overnight journey.Check in, refresh and settle into your allocated room before the sightseeing begins.The relaxed hotel setting gives you time to recharge in calm surroundings.Samharam Resort offers a welcoming introduction to the tropical character of Dhofar.Hotel allocation is Samharam Resort or a similar property, subject to availability.

Buffet Lunch at the Hotel

Begin your Salalah stay with a generous buffet lunch in the hotel restaurant.A welcoming indoor dining space makes it easy to relax after the long journey.Enjoy a convenient included meal before setting out for the spectacular west coast.The comfortable pause gives everyone time to refresh and prepare for the afternoon.This genuine Samharam Resort dining photograph shows the setting guests can expect.

Mughsail Beach

Mughsail Beach is a celebrated Dhofar shoreline where soft white sand stretches beside clear blue water.The beach extends for approximately six kilometres, creating generous space to admire the Arabian Sea.Coastal shelters make this an inviting place to pause, relax and enjoy the dramatic western landscape.Nearby frankincense trees connect the natural scenery with one of Oman’s most treasured traditions.Wide sea views, mountain backdrops and refreshing coastal air make Al Mughsail an unforgettable stop.

Marneef Cave

Explore Marneef Cave, the striking natural formation overlooking Al Mughsail’s famous coastal blowholes.The rugged limestone formation rises above the shore and frames impressive views of the Arabian Sea.Its sheltered setting offers a welcome place to pause while enjoying the sea breeze.Nearby viewpoints connect the cave, rocky coastline and powerful ocean in one memorable scene.Marneef Cave brings geology, fresh coastal air and dramatic scenery together beside Mughsail Beach.

Mughsail Blowholes

See one of Dhofar’s best-known natural spectacles on the rocky coast west of Salalah.Powerful waves push seawater through natural openings, sending sudden fountains high into the air.The experience is especially dramatic when the sea is rough and pressure builds beneath the rocks.Marneef Cave overlooks this coastal phenomenon, bringing two remarkable landmarks into one visit.Blowhole height and activity always depend on the season, tide and sea conditions on the day.

Cheraman Perumal Tomb

Discover a peaceful cultural site linked to the historic story of Kerala’s Cheraman Perumal.The modest tomb reflects the long relationship between Dhofar and the Indian subcontinent.Its quiet surroundings invite a respectful pause and a moment of historical reflection.The visit adds a meaningful human story to Salalah’s coastal and trading heritage.Guests are requested to dress modestly and respect the spiritual character of the site.

Souq Al Haffa

Explore Salalah’s celebrated waterfront souq in an elegant palm-lined Omani setting.Traditional-inspired architecture and inviting shopfronts create a relaxed evening atmosphere.Browse for frankincense, perfumes, textiles and distinctive souvenirs from Dhofar.Warm coastal light makes the market especially attractive as the sightseeing day winds down.Souq Al Haffa offers the perfect blend of local character, shopping and cultural discovery.

Buffet Dinner & Overnight at the Hotel

Return to the hotel and enjoy an included buffet dinner after the west-coast discoveries.Relax in comfortable resort surroundings while the evening settles over Salalah.The beachfront atmosphere gives the first sightseeing day a calm and satisfying finale.Share favourite moments from Mughsail before settling in for a restful night.Your first hotel night prepares you for the waterfalls and mountain viewpoints of Day 3.

Day 3

Explore the beauty of Salalah

Waterfalls • Mountain viewpoint • Springs

Breakfast + Lunch + Dinner

After breakfast at the hotel, depart for Wadi Darbat and Jabal Samhan Viewpoint, with a packed lunch in the mountains. Continue to the Location of Gravity, Ayn Razat and Ayn Sahalnoot, then return for buffet dinner and your second hotel night.

Breakfast & Morning Departure

Start the morning with breakfast at the hotel before the full nature tour begins.A relaxed buffet service provides a comfortable start to the most scenic day of the trip.Prepare for waterfalls, mountain air and the green landscapes of the Khareef season.The day is paced to combine Salalah’s most celebrated natural highlights in one journey.After breakfast, meet the tour team and depart for the eastern Dhofar countryside.

Wadi Darbat

Journey into Wadi Darbat, a secluded mountain valley overlooking Khor Rori near the coastal town of Taqah.A natural tufa dam shapes the landscape and helps form a beautiful ribbon of small lakes.During Khareef, seasonal water replenishes the valley and refreshes its celebrated green scenery.Open grasslands create peaceful places for picnics while local livestock graze across the wadi.Water, mountains and seasonal greenery make Wadi Darbat one of Dhofar’s essential nature experiences.

Jabal Samhan Viewpoint

Rise above Dhofar at Jabal Samhan Viewpoint, one of the region’s most impressive mountain panoramas.The high viewpoint opens across deep limestone valleys and vast layered cliffs.During Khareef, drifting clouds and cool mountain air add a wonderfully dramatic mood.Enjoy the packed lunch surrounded by scenery that feels peaceful and far from the city.This elevated stop delivers the scale and freshness travellers dream of in Salalah.

Location of Gravity

Experience Salalah’s famous gravity-road illusion among the open hills of Dhofar.Vehicles appear to move uphill, creating a surprising moment for everyone on the tour.The quiet road and rugged surroundings make the demonstration even more intriguing.It is a short, entertaining stop that adds variety to the nature-filled sightseeing day.This unusual roadside phenomenon is one of Salalah’s most talked-about travel curiosities.

Ayn Razat

Visit Ayn Razat, one of Dhofar’s most beautiful and abundant natural springs near Salalah.Flowing water, rocky scenery and rich plant life create a refreshing setting throughout the visit.The nearby Razat Cave adds another natural feature for travellers to explore and photograph.Surrounding vegetation also provides a welcoming habitat for local birds and wildlife.Ayn Razat combines water, greenery and mountain character in a calm and memorable landscape.

Ayn Sahalnoot

Discover Ayn Sahalnoot, a prominent perennial spring located only a short journey from central Salalah.Flowing water and lush surroundings create a refreshing contrast to Dhofar’s rugged mountains.The spring’s tranquil atmosphere offers a serene retreat during the full sightseeing day.Natural rock formations and clear water make the setting especially rewarding for photography.Ayn Sahalnoot is a peaceful oasis where visitors can appreciate the greener side of the region.

Buffet Dinner & Second Hotel Night

Return to the hotel after a rewarding day of waterfalls, mountains and natural springs.Enjoy a buffet dinner and time to relax in comfortable resort surroundings.Share the day’s favourite memories while preparing for the final Salalah sightseeing morning.The quiet evening provides a well-earned rest after the full nature itinerary.Your second hotel night completes the accommodation included in the package.

Day 4

Farewell Salalah

Breakfast • Cultural visit • Market • Departure

Breakfast + Lunch

Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel. Visit Nabi Ayub (Alayhi as-Salam) Tomb, then explore Salalah’s traditional fruits and vegetable market. Return to the hotel for buffet lunch before departing for Dubai by luxury bus, with a dinner stop at Haima Restaurant at your own expense.

Breakfast & Hotel Check-out

Enjoy breakfast at the hotel and prepare for the final morning in Salalah.Take time to collect your belongings and complete the hotel check-out comfortably.The morning schedule keeps the departure day relaxed while preserving two rewarding visits.Luggage arrangements are completed before the cultural and market stops begin.After check-out, meet the tour team for a memorable farewell to Dhofar.

Tomb of Prophet Nabi Ayub (Alayhi as-Salam)

Visit the peaceful mountain site traditionally associated with Prophet Ayub (Alayhi as-Salam), known as Job.A modest building and pale dome create a serene landmark in the surrounding mountain landscape.The surrounding landscape adds a quiet sense of reflection to this spiritual stop.Local tradition and the nearby spring give the site a distinctive place in Dhofar’s heritage.Guests are requested to dress modestly and behave respectfully throughout the visit.

Traditional Fruits & Vegetable Market

Enter Salalah’s Traditional Fruits & Vegetable Market beneath coconut and banana palms.Rustic stalls display fresh coconuts, bananas, papayas and colourful seasonal vegetables.The scene reflects the fertile character that makes Dhofar feel different from northern Oman.It is an inviting opportunity to appreciate local produce and everyday agricultural traditions.The palm-lined market provides a vibrant and authentic final taste of the Khareef destination.

Buffet Lunch at the Hotel

Return to the hotel restaurant and enjoy the final included buffet lunch in Salalah.The comfortable indoor setting gives everyone time to relax before the overnight return.A generous meal completes the touring program with a convenient and welcoming pause.After lunch, board the luxury bus and settle in for the journey back to the UAE.This genuine Samharam Resort photograph accurately shows the hotel dining environment.

Departure Transfer to Dubai

After the included hotel buffet lunch, board the luxury coach for the return journey.Settle into your seat and relax as the tour leaves Salalah for the UAE.A dinner stop is scheduled at Haima Restaurant, with the meal at your own expense.The coach continues overnight toward the border and onward to Dubai.Final arrival time remains subject to traffic, road conditions and border formalities.

Dinner Stop in Haima

Pause in Haima for a comfortable dinner break before the overnight road journey continues.The scheduled stop gives guests time to refresh, use the facilities and enjoy a relaxed meal.A generous Omani-style mixed grill may include rice, chicken, lamb, kebabs, salad and warm flatbread.The dinner at the Haima restaurant is not included in the package and is paid directly by each guest.After the break, reboard the luxury coach and continue north toward the UAE border.

Oman entry & travel documents

Visa-free entry or visa on arrival is available only for selected eligible nationalities and is always subject to Oman immigration approval.

  • Entry is subject to Oman Government approval.
  • Dependent visa holders must apply for an Oman visa.
  • Visit visa holders and visa-change cases are not allowed.
  • Passengers are solely responsible for meeting passport and visa requirements; immigration authorities make the final decision.
  • Passports must be valid for at least six months from departure, and Emirates IDs for at least three months.
  • Visa on arrival is available only to certain nationalities and remains subject to immigration discretion.
  • An Oman eVisa is advised for a smoother travel experience.
  • Skymundo is not responsible if a traveller cannot travel for passport, visa or personal reasons.
Important traveller, room & seating notes
  • Carry basic medicines and keep all documents safe.
  • No liquor items are permitted; alcohol is strictly prohibited.
  • Bedding preferences, room view, balcony, window, amenities, interconnected rooms, family rooms and nearby rooms are subject to hotel availability and cannot be guaranteed.
  • Seats are allocated in booking order, with earlier bookings receiving front seats where possible.
  • Special seat requests are subject to availability; no seat can be guaranteed and allocations may change.
Confirmation, cancellation & changes

Once confirmed, the booking is 100% non-refundable. However, the booking may be transferred to another person through a name change for a valid reason, provided the request is submitted at least 10 days before the departure date.

  • Confirmation is subject to availability and full payment at the time of booking.
  • Without full payment, no booking is guaranteed.
  • Skymundo may cancel or modify the itinerary or package elements due to unforeseen circumstances, force majeure or operational reasons.

Frequently Asked Questions

Five essential answers before you book your Salalah escape.

What does the Salalah package include?

The package includes round-trip luxury-bus transportation between the UAE and Oman, guided sightseeing, a full-time tour manager, travel insurance, visa and border assistance, daily bottled water, hotel accommodation and meals as listed in the itinerary.

Which travel dates and UAE pickup locations are available?

Select one of the listed departures in the booking form. Pickup options are Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Abu Dhabi and Al Ain. Availability, meeting points and timings depend on the selected departure and must be confirmed with Skymundo.

Which hotel will we stay at?

Accommodation is at Samharam Resort or a similar hotel, subject to availability. Room preferences, views, bedding arrangements, early check-in and late check-out cannot be guaranteed.

Is visa-free entry or visa on arrival guaranteed?

No. Visa-free entry or visa on arrival is available only to selected eligible nationalities and remains subject to Oman immigration approval. Travellers are responsible for valid passports, Emirates IDs and any required visa.

How do payment, confirmation and cancellation work?

Choose from Tabby, Tamara, Payment Link, Bank Transfer, or Cash / Card Payment at Our Office. Confirmation is subject to availability and full payment. Once confirmed, the booking is 100% non-refundable; a name change may be requested for a valid reason at least 10 days before departure.
